abstract: Nanoparticle-based drugs face challenges of weak spatiotemporal control and difficulty in elucidating their mechanisms of action. We designed a stimulus-responsive delivery system based on targeted peptides and quantum dots (QDs) to achieve synergistic therapy combining sonodynamic therapy (SDT) and immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). Using spatially resolved proteomics technology, we analyzed the mechanism underlying this synergy.
